---
title: "Haye Sajjad Diyaan Akhiyaan Rat Roiyaan Lyrics In Punjabi 2018"
language: "Panjabi"
lang: "pa"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Other"
poet: "Sabir"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Haye Sajjad Diyaan Akhiyaan Rat Roiyaan.
Phophiyaan Mawaan Ban Qaidi Jadon Bazar Gayiyaan.
Loag Beemar Toon Aye Pochday Ray Ayho Ghazi Di Bhain Zainab Aye.
Safraan Andar Qatal Kita Aynj Sajjd Kayiyaan.

2
Sanj Veraan De Naal Bhaina Ne Ewein Har Moor Te Nibhai Aye.
Othay Baqi Sir Na Re Aithey Chadraan Na Rayiyaan.
Naaz Babay Sada Uthaye San Ki Sakina Te Waqat Aaya Aye.
Jane Bibi( Kiwein Har Ja Haye Jhirkaan Ne Sayiyaan.

3
Qaid Zindan Di Te Muk Gayi Aye Khon Akhiyaan Choon Aidi Nayi Rukna.
Aine Takiya Wich Safraan Jiwein Bhaina Turiyaan.
Aakhri Sa Beemar De Lab Te Wain Haye Sham Da Riya Sabir.
Manzar Akhiyaan Wich Reh Gaye Moor Rawaan Galiyaan.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/haye-sajjad-diyaan-akhiyaan-rat-roiyaan-lyrics-in-punjabi-2018-tajpoints-0a5fd24510e0dc041bf8.md')
_, header, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 3
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == number and len(lines) == 5
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines() if line)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Both editions have three numbered stanzas of four verses.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Sajjd kayiyaan” as «سجاد کئیاں» and “Jane Bibi” as «جانے بی بی». Both readings are tentative.
